query: SELECT DISTINCT subgroup, campus, year, COUNT(*) as weeks, SUM(headcount) as total FROM attendance_weekly WHERE subgroup IN ('Salvations', 'Baptisms', 'Stewardship') GROUP BY subgroup, campus, year ORDER BY year DESC, subgroup, campus;
